title: ICT verdict in Abdul Quader Mollah case sparks immediate reaction
detail: A section of citizens, especially younger activists, viewed the sentence as inadequate and called for stronger accountability for 1971 war crimes.

title: Shahbag gatherings begin and expand rapidly
detail: Protesters assembled at Shahbag and maintained continuous public presence through slogans, speeches, and mass participation.

title: Bloggers, students, and cultural workers sustain the platform
detail: The movement developed a civic-organizing rhythm with online mobilization, public performances, and coordinated demonstrations.

title: Counter-mobilizations and political polarization intensify
detail: As Shahbag drew large support, opposition responses and street tensions deepened wider political confrontation across the country.

title: Justice-memory discourse enters mainstream political language
detail: Even as street momentum fluctuated, the movement left a durable imprint on national discussions of 1971 memory, justice, and civic action.
